Test Case Title: all products list and product detail page
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Test Steps:
1. Open /products and verify "All Products" and the product list.
2. Click "View Product" of the first product.
3. Verify name, category, price, availability, condition and brand.
Expected Result: The product detail page shows all product details (price "Rs. ...", In Stock, New).
